reason: I only make about $16,000 a year as a student, so taking on another recurring subscription isn't realistic for my budget. When I'm spiraling late at night I'd love support, but I can't justify paying $10 a month when money is this tight.
objection: $9.99 a month is way too steep for what might just turn out to be a glorified chatbot.
would_change_my_mind: A usable free tier for late-night venting or a student discount around $3 a month.
